main_text.p: singula sunt Prærogativæ Chri-sto σωτῆρι[?] propriæ) Redimendi, immediatè illuminandi, Regenerandi, gratiam primam conferendi, justificandiq virtutem, tanquam ex Christi Meritis, sibi arrogaret. Quod absque nefando sacrilegio fieri non posse, vel Pontificii ipsi concedunt ultro.

5. Hâc arte non succedunt: Novo fascino tenera ingenia corripere satagunt. Solifidianorum Hæresis scilicet Protestantibus impingenda est, quippe sublatâ opinione Meriti de condigno, bonorum operum gloriam omnem obfuscari, necessitatem bene operandi tolli, & nihil non flagitii perpetrandi licentiam ho-

page.notes: The first word of the page reads "singula" with the long s, printed in a form resembling f; transcribed as the plain s of "singula". The Greek word after "Christo" is partly blurred; "σωτῆρι" is a best reading and is marked [?]. The catchword "minibus" is printed at the right below the last line, and the text ends on the hyphenated "ho-". No page number, marginal notes or signature are visible. The scan is faded in places, but all printed lines are legible.
